info.title: ATB API
info.description:
The Automated Topology Builder API, version 1. JSON over HTTPS; base URL `https://atb.uq.edu.au/api/v1`.

## Getting a key

Log in, open **Manage Account → API keys**, and create a key. An existing key can create more with `POST /me/keys`.
The key is shown once; the ATB keeps only its hash. Send it on every request:

    Authorization: Bearer atb_...

## Scopes

| Scope | Allows |
|---|---|
| `read` | Search, metadata, status, files, reference data, your jobs. |
| `submit` | Submit molecules, structure search, remap. |
| `manage` | Your molecules (publish, label, delete) and your keys. |
| `admin` | `/admin/*`. Granted per key to administrators. |

A new key gets `read submit manage` unless you ask for fewer. `service`, `pipeline:*` and `root` keys belong to
the ATB's own components, not to users.

## Limits

Each key has a burst limit (a token bucket per minute) and a daily budget of weighted requests (UTC day). The
submission and unfinished-job caps are per account; submissions reset at midnight AEST.

| Who | Burst per minute | Daily weight | Submissions per day | Unfinished jobs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| User, class 2 (academic) | 60 | 2000 | 100 | 4 |
| User, classes 3-6 | 120 | 5000 | 250 | 8 |
| Key holding `admin` | 120 | 5000 | no cap | 16 |
| No key (`/health`, `/docs`, `/openapi.json`) | 10 per IP | - | - | - |

- Weights: metadata 1, file download 2, submission, bundle, remap and flag 5, structure search and partial-text
  search 10. Each operation below states its weight.
- Free against the daily budget (weight 0): molecule status, `/molecules/changes`, `/jobs/*`, `/me/usage`, and a
  `304`. Every keyed call still spends one burst token.
- Responses carry `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining`, `RateLimit-Reset` (burst) and `X-ATB-Daily-Limit`,
  `X-ATB-Daily-Remaining` (daily).
- Over a limit: `429` with `Retry-After` (seconds). To ask for more, `POST /me/quota-requests`.

## Long operations

Generating a topology, submitting, searching by structure, bundles and remaps may take a while. These take
`?wait=<seconds>` (default 30, at most 120):

- done within `wait`: the normal answer (`200`/`201`);
- not done: `202` with `Location: /api/v1/jobs/{id}`. Poll that (free) until `state` is `done` or `failed`;
  `GET /jobs/{id}/result` then returns the answer or the zip. Zips are kept 48 hours.

## Errors

Errors are RFC 9457 problem details (`application/problem+json`): `type`, `title`, `status`, `detail`, plus
fields specific to the error. The last path segment of `type` is a stable slug; match on it, not on the text.

| Slug | Status | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `validation` | 400 | A parameter or body field is invalid; `errors` lists which. |
| `authentication-required` | 401 | No key was sent. |
| `invalid-key` | 401 | The key is unknown (also `key-revoked`, `key-expired`). |
| `insufficient-scope` | 403 | The key lacks the scope the operation needs. |
| `molecule-not-found` | 404 | No such molecule, or not visible to this key. |
| `file-not-found` | 404 | The file does not exist for this molecule. |
| `duplicate-molecule` | 409 | The structure is already in the ATB; `molid` names it. |
| `job-not-finished` | 409 | Poll `GET /jobs/{id}` until `done`. |
| `topology-version-gone` | 410 | The `?hash=` topology version is no longer stored. |
| `job-result-expired` | 410 | A job's zip is gone; run the job again. |
| `structure-unreadable` | 422 | The uploaded structure could not be parsed. |
| `chemistry-rejected` | 422 | The structure was read but refused; `detail` says why. |
| `rate-limited` | 429 | Burst limit; wait `Retry-After` seconds. |
| `daily-limit-exceeded` | 429 | Daily budget spent; resets 00:00 UTC. |
| `submission-limit-reached` | 429 | Daily submission cap reached; resets at midnight AEST. |
| `too-many-jobs` | 429 | Too many unfinished jobs; wait for one or cancel one. |
| `service-unavailable` | 503 | A backend is down; retry after `Retry-After`. |

## Files

File names are `<format>_<aa|ua>[_opt|_unopt]`: all-atom or united-atom, optimised or unoptimised geometry,
e.g. `itp_aa`, `pdb_ua_opt`. Molecule-level files have plain names (`pdb_user`, `qm_data`, `qm1_log`).
`GET /molecules/{molid}/files` lists them. The v0.1 names (`itp_allatom`, `pdb_allatom_optimised`, ...) are
accepted as aliases. `?hash=` selects a stored topology version; `410 topology-version-gone` means it is no
longer stored (old versions cannot be rebuilt). QM logs and `qm_data` are restricted.

## Molecule status

`GET /molecules/{molid}/status` (free) returns `stage`:

| Stage | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `queued` | Submitted; no QM level yet. |
| `qm0` | Semi-empirical pre-optimisation (GFN2-xTB), running or waiting. |
| `qm1` | DFT geometry optimisation (wB97X, SMD water), running or waiting. |
| `qm2` | DFT Hessian at the qm1 geometry, running or waiting. |
| `finished` | All QM levels done; topology available. Terminal. |
| `capped` | Finished below qm2 (size limit or curation); topology available. Terminal. |
| `stalled` | Will not move without an administrator. Not terminal. |
| `failed` | A calculation failed; see `error`. Terminal. |
| `rejected` | Refused at qm0 (e.g. impossible charge, or its bonds changed on relaxing). Terminal. |

## Python client

`pip install "git+https://github.com/ATB-UQ/atb_client"` ([source and documentation](https://github.com/ATB-UQ/atb_client)).

```python
from atb_client import ATBClient
atb = ATBClient()                      # key from ATB_API_KEY
mol = atb.molecules.submit(structure=open("lig.pdb").read(), format="pdb", netcharge=0, public=True)
mol = mol.wait(timeout=6 * 3600)       # polls the free status route
mol.files.download("itp_aa", "lig.itp")
for hit in atb.molecules.search(formula="C6H6"): print(hit.molid, hit.common_name)
```

## API v0.1

The older API under `/api/v0.1/` is still served; it will be deprecated. New work should use v1.

get.description:
Whether the database, Redis and the job broker are reachable. `503` when the database is
down. Cached for a few seconds; limited per IP.

**Access** no key needed.

The calling key: its principal, scopes, expiry and effective limits, and the account it belongs to.

**Scope** any key · **Weight** 1

Weighted requests spent today (UTC) by this key, and by each of the account's keys. Free.

**Scope** any key · **Weight** 0

Every key of the account, revoked and expired ones included. Never the secrets. User keys only.

**Scope** `manage` · **Weight** 1

post.description:
Mint a key for your account. The secret (`key`) is in this response only.

The new key holds at most the calling key's scopes (within `read submit manage`) and expires no later
than it; it inherits the calling key's limits. `403 key-escalation` otherwise; `409 key-limit-reached`
at the per-account cap. User keys only.

**Scope** `manage` · **Weight** 1

delete.description:
Revoke one of the account's keys, and every key it minted. A key cannot revoke the key that
minted it, directly or further up (`403 key-ancestor`). `204` on success.

**Scope** `manage` · **Weight** 1

grouping.description: `tautomer_group_id` (legacy) or `skeleton_key` (graph keys). A graph-key `skeleton_key` (`S1-...`, from `compound_graph_keys`) is the grouping that supersedes it, and is accepted in the same place.
